gaps.lead: Reporters expect the trial to last several weeks.
gaps.explanation: 'Reporters expect it to last' becomes 'it is expected to last'.

gaps.lead: You can only get a seat if you book well in advance.
gaps.explanation: if you don't book = without booking.

gaps.lead: He is so impatient that he refuses to read instructions.
gaps.explanation: so impatient that he refuses = far too impatient to.

gaps.lead: The committee probably won't change the rules.
gaps.sentence: ___ the committee will change the rules.
gaps.explanation: probably won't = it is (highly) unlikely that.

gaps.lead: No changes will be made to this project.
gaps.hint: go ahead = proceed; according to plan
gaps.explanation: 'No changes' means the project 'will go ahead according to plan'.

gaps.lead: The rescue team managed to reach the village by helicopter.
gaps.sentence: The rescue team ___ the village by helicopter.
gaps.explanation: manage to do = succeed IN doing.
